methodology.stages: hierarchical batched microbenchmarks plus uninstrumented session decode totals
methodology.cold_path: new prefilled session per measured decode
methodology.warm_steady_state: same prefilled session, unchanged block table
methodology.boundary_growth: prefill at page boundary, append crossing boundary, then decode
methodology.instrumentation_inflation: fine-grained timers are outside the primary decode total; totals are measured uninstrumented
